taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-02, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as Q-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-02, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-02 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-02 presents a 6-layer geoelectric section characterized by a continuous decrease in resistivity with depth:
- **Layer 1** (0–20.07 m): 31,374.7 Ω·m
- **Layer 2** (20.07–32.86 m): 7,559.9 Ω·m
- **Layer 3** (32.86–34.48 m): 3,573.3 Ω·m
- **Layer 4** (34.48–73.38 m): 313.2 Ω·m
- **Layer 5** (73.38–73.79 m): 53.6 Ω·m
- **Layer 6** (>73.79 m): 22.8 Ω·m (basement/conductive zone)

Evaluating successive three-layer triplets gives the sequence Q-Q-Q-Q (since $r_1 > r_2 > r_3$ holds across all intervals). Because all segment letters are identical, the sounding is properly designated as a Q-type curve, fully consistent with the classification on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "Q", "label_issue_flagged": false}
